name: plan-flow
description: Write implementation plans with an immutable intent, a tested edge-case matrix and an annotated code map, then execute them task by task against that frozen contract, in a context scoped to one task at a time.

progressPane.title: Plan progress pane
progressPane.description: auto opens the pane when you start executing a plan; command opens it only through its own command; off turns the pane and its observation off.

progressCheckPattern.title: Check command pattern
progressCheckPattern.description: A regular expression, matched against the program and subcommand words of each part of an executor shell command (not file names, paths, flags or quoted arguments); a matching part is shown as a check, besides the task's own Verification commands. git commands never count.
